title: Another channeler also predicted the Challenger disaster
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Another channeler also predicted the Challenger disaster, about 1986 at San Francisco Bay Area, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: afterwards I heard from them saying they knew of a another channeler somewhere who had made the same prediction.

plain: A psychology researcher and interviewer, Jeffrey Mishlove, says that in the San Francisco Bay Area a channeler, someone who claims to pass on messages from spirits or other beings, foretold the 1986 Challenger disaster, when a NASA space shuttle broke apart after launch. He says that afterwards he heard from people at the Foundation for Mind Being Research, a local group, that they knew of another channeler who had made the same prediction. If true, it would suggest such people can sense future events.
